title: Complementary Gaussian quantiles
statement: For every real number $a$ with $0<a<1$, the standard Gaussian quantiles satisfy $Q(1-a)=-Q(a)$.
replaced: Let $\Phi$ and $\varphi$ be the standard Gaussian distribution function and density, and put $Q=\Phi^{-1}$ and $I(p)=\varphi(Q(p))$ for $0<p<1$. For every $a\in(0,1)$, $Q(1-a)=-Q(a)$.
